name: Love Song for Narain
summary: Meridith the Mermaiden has a message for Narain Soothfancy, the gnome she once rescued from the wreckage of a crashed flying machine. She asks you to carry her love letter to him in Tanaris. You can take this up while seeking Narain's book in Draconic for Dummies.

sections.title: A Message for the Shore
sections.body: Meridith the Mermaiden seldom has visitors. The last was the gnome she rescued from the wreckage of a crashed flying machine, and she gazes into nothing for a moment, lost in the memory. She asks whether you know Narain Soothfancy, because she has to tell him how she feels, and she is sure it is love. She begs you to carry a message to him, and promises to be forever in your debt.

sections.title: Narain's Answer
sections.body: Narain Soothfancy remarks that you smell of fish. When he learns what the letter says, he fidgets and protests that she is a fish and he is a gnome, so it could never work out.

faq.answer: Meridith is a mermaiden who seldom has visitors. The last was the gnome she rescued from a crashed flying machine, Narain Soothfancy.

faq.q: How does Meridith know Narain Soothfancy?
faq.answer: She rescued him from the wreckage of his crashed flying machine, and she believes she is in love with him.
It is Meridith's message to Narain Soothfancy, telling him how she feels. She wants it delivered to him in Tanaris.

aliases: prerequisite for love song for narain
faq.answer: Draconic for Dummies comes before it. Meridith offers her request to those already seeking Narain's buried book.
